Game Overview

At its heart, Falling Balls is a educational game about guide a cascade of colorful, bouncing balls through dynamic 2.5D puzzles by carving pathways with precision. Strategically navigate obstacles to maximize ball collection and unleash their vibrant hues. Rack up points, unlock dazzling skins, and conquer each level's intricate challenges in this gravity-fueled, physics-driven adventure!
